topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: The news floats around us, a leaf in autumn, and I catch it softly, not wanting to snatch or bruise. We sit in the center of our usual chaos, where whispers and laughter often mingle, but now a new current runs beneath it. I trace the lines of your face, the map of our friendship, and I think of the miles that sound like oceans now. I promise, in the silence that settles between us, that this map will grow, not shrink. That we will find new ways to meet, even if the air between us stretches thin and cold. For you, these words are just a start, a thread to hold until we find the next knot to tie us closer.
